source.name: Draco Impact
source.originalDescription: Briefly fly up in the air, becoming untargetable, before crashing down, approximately 2s after activating, with several comets on a designated area, dealing damage and throwing enemies in the area for 0.5s. The farther Dragonite flies, the more the Unite gauge is consumed (50% at min distance and 100% at max). Dragonite is unstoppable while using this move. Briefly fly up in the air before crashing down with several comets on a designated area, dealing damage and throwing enemies in the area. The farther Dragonite flies, the more the Unite guage is consumed (25% at min disatance and 100% at max). Dragonite is unstoppable while using this move. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Draco Impact は 相手を打ち上げる、相手を引き寄せる、妨害無効になる、対象指定されない、またはステルス状態になる、シールドを付与する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。
